exposure: Surgeon specialty for hysterectomy (general obstetrician-gynecologists, maternal-fetal medicine specialists, and gynecologic oncologists)
cohort: 2240 patients with placenta accreta spectrum who underwent cesarean delivery and concurrent hysterectomy from 2016 to 2020
finding: Patient characteristics and surgical procedures related to cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum differ based on surgeon specialty, with gynecologic oncologists managing more severe cases, but surgical morbidity remains significant regardless of specialty.
